description: This file defines the WorkoutCardPresenter class, which extends the Presenter class to create and manage UI presentation of workout media cards in an Android TV application. It handles view creation, styling, focus animations, binding workout data to views, and click interactions.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class for rendering workout media cards with focus effects, styling, and click handling in an Android TV app.

methods.name: dp
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on device density.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates and configures the view holder, setting up the ImageCardView with styling, focus animations, and layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Workout data object to the view, setting titles, meta info, images, content descriptions, and click behavior.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Cleans up the view references when the presenter unbinds the view holder.
